messages.text: This is frustrating.  But understandable.  What would be a huge thank you for everyone from phase 1 that stayed with it, is to offer a second chance within 60 days of delivery to pick up another one at that introductory price.  This allows a full 60 day evaluation, and an informed decision/review of what was promised vs the actuality.  I for one, if this does live up to or exceed expectations, would probably buy a second.     Food for thought.  Pat    Sent from my iPhone
Handed to the team · pricing / loyalty offer decision is not mine to make

Hi Patrick,

Thank you for taking it the way you have, and for the idea. Honestly, that is a good one, and it is exactly the kind of thing we should be doing for the people who were in from the start at $649.

It is not mine to decide, so I have put it straight in front of Georges and Abel with your words attached. A colleague is picking it up today and will come back to you on it. I am not going to promise you a yes before they have answered, but I will say your case for it is a strong one, and you are the right person to be making it.

On your own unit, nothing changes: all 300 are being built together, and Magic Miner expects them to ship out from the factory on November 12. Your tracking comes to you by email the moment yours ships.

Thanks again for sticking with us, Pat.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
